provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific measurement/decision example; stipulated model inputs and observations, not new experimental findings.
provenance.scope: All required information, units and inferential limits are in this document.

model: y=mu+epsilon at this fixed design; independent zero-mean Gaussian errors have known common variance. The two supplied columns form the entire fitted basis; both coefficients are penalized by alpha, including the constant column. A candidate uses H=X(X^T X+alpha I)^(-1)X^T. Squared-error risk concerns the latent mean vector mu at these same four locations, averaged per scalar response.
criterion: For each fixed alpha use Stein unbiased risk estimate SURE=(||y-Hy||^2+2*sigma2*trace(H)-n*sigma2)/n. Choose its minimum, breaking numerical ties within1e-10 by smaller alpha. A selected minimum after searching the same y need not remain unbiased for the risk of the selected procedure.
scope: No held-out performance or risk uncertainty bound is requested.
